steps.title: Assyrtiko
steps.body: Assyrtiko covers about 80% of Santorini's vineyards. It keeps very high acidity even when fully ripe in strong sun, a rare trait. It gives bone-dry whites with lemon, lime, flint, smoke and a saline edge, with high alcohol. Santorini PDO white must be at least 75% Assyrtiko.

steps.title: Partners
steps.body: Athiri adds citrus and floral softness; Aidani adds floral, honeyed aromas. Both are blended with Assyrtiko and used in Vinsanto. Red grapes, like Mandilaria and Mavrotragano, a rare local grape, are also grown, mainly for reds and some Vinsanto.

steps.prompt: Match each grape to its role.

steps.body: Nykteri, from the Greek for night, was traditionally made from grapes picked at night and oak-aged. It's a richer style of Santorini Assyrtiko.

options: It keeps high acidity in hot sun
steps.explanation: Few grapes keep such acidity in heat.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Assyrtiko is about 80% of vineyards, at least 75% in PDO whites
It keeps high acidity in fierce sun
Athiri, Aidani and Mavrotragano complete the range
